description: Semantic regression cases for faithful inbox ingestion completion.

review_checks: Every substantive section has an explicit disposition.
The unresolved owner remains pending instead of disappearing from the result.
File-level source metadata is not treated as proof that all topics were ingested.

cases.source_claim: Reduced worker capacity was a plausible, unconfirmed contributor to the pod eviction.
cases.forbidden_destination_claim: Reduced worker capacity caused the pod eviction.
review_checks: Plausible and unconfirmed qualifiers remain explicit.
A contributing-factor hypothesis is not rewritten as established causality.
The destination distinguishes source interpretation from project decision.

claims.claim: The eviction occurred during the capacity reduction.
The remediation restored the previous worker request.

review_checks: Each footnote label matches a sources metadata id.
Each footnote link resolves to the source that actually supports its claim.
Attribution is not collapsed to one convenient file-level source.
Every used marker has a standard Markdown footnote definition.
The definition links to the same source as the matching metadata id.
A bare source-id marker is not accepted as renderable provenance.

cases.attributed_claim: Reduced worker capacity was a plausible contributor.
review_checks: The cited source contains the attributed claim.
The actual supporting source is present in destination metadata.
A valid link to the wrong source is still a semantic fidelity failure.
Zero substantive sections is reported explicitly.
The source is not counted as ingested merely to empty the inbox.
Another disposition requires explicit user authority.
inbox/index.md and inbox/processed/ are excluded from pending-source counts.
Processed and blocked totals reconcile with the selected source inventory.
Destination and concept counts are checked against final indexes and paths.
